item.title: Trump administration appeals decision releasing Hudson Tunnel funds

item.title: MxV Rail offering student grant program for AAR Research Review
item.description: PUEBLO, Colo. — MxV Rail is launching a student travel grant program to enable future rail researchers and engineers to attend this year’s Association of American Railroads Research Review, set for April 28-30, 2026, at MxV Rail’s facility in Pueblo. item.title: CSX signs $670 million locomotive deal with Wabtec
item.description: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. — CSX has signed a $670 million deal with Wabtec to upgrade its locomotive fleet with 100 new locomotives and 50 modernized units, as well as related digital systems. The deal calls for new Evolution Series locomotives as well as DC-to-AC upgrades for Dash-9 locomotives. It is the latest in a flurry of [...]Read More...

item.title: BNSF, Union Pacific deliver perfect peak seasons for intermodal customers
item.description: BNSF Railway and Union Pacific say they delivered perfect peak seasons for their parcel customers during the holiday rush of 2025.
